correctness.rationale: Polar-line reduction plus a sum-of-four-squares identity determines the normal form from the incidence data. Four pairs meet in order four; the two opposite pairs give four transverse points each, by explicit resultants, and all triple intersections are excluded. The symbolic-in-t cubic syzygy is checked by exact expansion, and the Dimca–Sernesi bound at Arnold exponent 5/8 yields minimal degree three. Tjurina number 36 satisfies the standard nearly-free numerical criterion.
